0022600031.text: The New Orleans Pelicans host the Minnesota Timberwolves in the ninth game of the 2026-27 season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup. New Orleans is 4-4 and 10th in the West, 2.5 games back in the Southwest, after winning its last four games, and it is 3-2 at home. Minnesota is 6-3, on a two-game win streak, 3rd in the Northwest and 8th in the West, and is missing Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while Yves Missi (knee bruise) is out for New Orleans. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Pelicans lost the season series 1-3, including a 132-126 defeat in Minneapolis on April 12, 2026.
